doc.title: Marian McPartland — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Jazz movies: 'Round Midnight, Bird and the planned Strayhorn film
summary: She praises Dexter Gordon in 'Round Midnight, thinks the film Bird overdid the drugs, and notes a Billy Strayhorn film is planned.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Jazz musicians on film and studio scoring

blocks.x: Real quickly, while we’re on the subject, what about some of the movies that were made regarding music, for instance like Lady Sings the Blues or ’Round Midnight? Did you have any, did you have . . .
Oh I saw that. I saw those. Oh yeah.
Do you have any opinions on those, any short opinions?
Yeah, I saw those. I thought Dexter Gordon did a great job of playing himself.
No, I liked that movie. I thought that was quite well done. Now wait a minute. There was one that Clint Eastwood did. The one about . . .
The one about Bird. I thought he was too hot and heavy on the fact of him doing drugs.
Yeah. I think what happened, what I heard, is that they just bought that script, and they really didn’t go through it like they should have.
They really should have edited. O.k. Something else I wanted to ask you is . . .
Before you do that, there’s another one coming up. They’re doing, going to do one on Billy Strayhorn, aren’t they?
Are they going to do the Billy . . .
